{{Top|leg}}
A '''stone eel''' was a type of aquatic creature from [[Storthus]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a number of stone eels were kept inside the [[Royal Icqui Aquaria]], an aquarium that was situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
